selection.purpose: User-requested full-range finite-bond TN scan; no threshold fit
selection.zero_interpretation: The analytical failure probability is zero. One deterministic TN implementation check per size is recorded separately, not as 1,000 sampled histories.
selection.seed_policy: Unique fixed Random.Xoshiro seeds for every size/rate, separate from the old pilot and diagnostics.
selection.validation_gate: validation/gates.json must explicitly pass each production size at the frozen contraction settings. L3 also requires an independent exact reference for every production history.
selection.halt_policy: A timeout, worker failure, unknown or invalid result, missing exact reference, or non-tied exact ML disagreement blocks further points of that size. Resume never retries a blocked point unless --retry-blocked is explicitly supplied.
selection.unknown_policy: Retain every requested history; missing or invalid outcomes are unknown, never successes or dropped samples. Never substitute exact output for a TN result.
selection.physical_preparation: Independent noisy seed-H outputs, complete initial seed MWPM repair, diagonal H+6CNOT transfer with independent Z gate-output faults; no later feedback.
selection.decoder_information: TN: seed and final syndromes plus known seed recovery. Paired final MWPM: final syndrome only.

zero_policy: p=0 is the exact analytical model value, not 1000 observed successes. Numerical zero checks are separate regressions with no binomial interval.
incomplete_policy: No rate until the entire requested target is complete and validated. F known failures and U unknown histories give [F/N,(F+U)/N] over the full target. These are outcome bounds, not confidence intervals.
pilot_policy: Earlier pilot observations are shown separately and never pooled into the newly requested target.
intervals: Pointwise 95% Wilson intervals only for complete validated nonzero-p targets.
model: Z-only gate-output faults, diagonal H+6CNOT preparation, initial seed MWPM repair, no later preparation feedback; TN uses both seed and final syndromes.
